scripts-descriptions.setup: Inspect and guide the local WordPress and test-tool setup.
scripts-descriptions.doctor: Run the read-only DDEV and PHPUnit safety preflight.
scripts-descriptions.lint:wpcs: Check all non-ignored PHP files against WordPress Coding Standards.
scripts-descriptions.format:wpcs: Automatically fix WordPress Coding Standards violations where possible.
scripts-descriptions.tail:log: Follow the local WordPress debug log inside the running DDEV project.
scripts-descriptions.clear:log: Safely truncate the local WordPress debug log.
scripts-descriptions.db:pull: Confirm, snapshot, download, verify, and import the configured remote database.
scripts-descriptions.snapshot: Create a named local DDEV database snapshot.
scripts-descriptions.restore: Confirm and restore a named local DDEV database snapshot.
scripts-descriptions.reset:tests: Confirm and recreate only the local wp_tests database.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the default PHP tests followed by the browser tests.
scripts-descriptions.test:php: Run the default WordPress PHP integration profile.
scripts-descriptions.test:harness: Run only the toolkit harness tests.
scripts-descriptions.test:plugin: Run a focused plugin profile; pass the plugin slug after --.
scripts-descriptions.test:theme: Run a focused theme profile; pass the theme slug after --.
scripts-descriptions.test:destructive: Run tests in the destructive PHPUnit group.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run tests with opt-in code coverage.
scripts-descriptions.test:junit: Run tests and write a JUnit report.
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e: Run local browser tests and restore the working site afterward.
